description: A bare `.A :> return` arm of a match at the top of a `${}` logic block has no function to leave: E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION (S462 review F4).
rationale: §18.2 "Leaving arms": legality by context — `return` needs an enclosing function. Emitted as-is it left the client's init function and skipped the event wiring after it.
